title: Villa Interior Design 179 m² in Madrid | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 179 m² villa in Madrid: design project, 3D visualisation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Luxury interior design project of a 179 m² villa in Madrid, Spain

blocks.text: Luxury interior design project of a 179 m² villa in Madrid, Spain

parts.html: In this project, DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed a full-scope luxury interior design project for a 179 m² villa in Madrid, Spain. The scope of work included interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture design and production, and turnkey renovation.

The design covered all areas of the villa, including the living room, bedrooms, kitchen with tailored storage solutions and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom, cabinets, and shelving.
Bespoke furniture was designed for each area, carefully tailored to the architecture of the villa as well as the client’s individual needs, preferences, and lifestyle.

Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering every stage of the project — from construction and finishing works to materials, custom furniture, appliances, plumbing, and lighting.
The project is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations, showcasing the interior concept, materials, furniture solutions, lighting, and overall atmosphere of the villa.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) creates premium residential interiors in Spain, Slovakia, across Europe, and the USA, providing comprehensive services from interior design and technical documentation to bespoke furniture production and turnkey implementation.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — interiors that come to life.
